sources.title: Yangshuo West Street: Foods, Stays, and Travel Tips
sources.content:
Yangshuo West Street: Complete Text Content

Overview
Yangshuo West Street is a 517-meter-long, 8-meter-wide commercial street in the heart of town with over 1,400 years of history. Located 30 minutes from Longtoushan Pier, it embodies a "global village" atmosphere where residents often converse in English. Visiting on weekdays is recommended, as the street becomes exceptionally crowded during holidays and weekends.

Food & Dining
The street features numerous restaurants serving diverse cuisines. "For reliable quality and transparent pricing, we recommend opting for established chain restaurants." Well-known options include:
- Chunji Roast Goose: Known for crispy-skinned, tender roast goose
- Laobiaoji: Serves authentic Guangxi dishes
- Liaoge Crucian Carp: Features generous portions of affordable fish specialties
- International chains like McDonald's and KFC are readily available

Professional guides can recommend halal, vegetarian, or specialty restaurants tailored to dietary preferences.

Shopping & Souvenirs
"Be prepared to bargain if the price is not clearly stated, and politely decline unreasonable offers." Prices are typically higher than downtown Guilin due to the popular scenic location.
Recommended souvenir shops with clearly marked prices:
- Momicafe
- Grey Ink
- Osmanthus
- Fingertip Craft Workshop

Nightlife & Evening Activities
The street transforms after dark with vibrant entertainment options:
- Bars: Mixology Homebar, Kaya Reggae Bar, Xiaoma's Sky Folk Bar
- Night Market: Shopping for snacks and souvenirs
- Cultural Shows: Impression of Sanjie Liu and Guilin Eternal Love
- Golden Dragon Bamboo Rafts: Weekend displays (6-8 PM Saturdays)

Accommodation
The street offers convenient transportation, diverse dining, and affordable hotels. However, it may not suit seniors seeking quieter venues due to nighttime noise from bars and activity. The Shili Gallery Area is recommended for stunning rural scenery and tranquility.

Transportation & Getting Around
- From Guilin: 4-hour Li River cruise or 2-hour private transfer
- Within Yangshuo: Best explored on foot through historic bluestone lanes
- Countryside exploration: Bicycles or electric scooters recommended for navigating rural roads

sources.title: West Street Yangshuo: Pedestrian Street for Bars, Shopping & Drinking
sources.content:
West Street Yangshuo - Complete Text Content

Location & Overview
West Street is situated in the county center of Yangshuo County, Guilin City. This thousand-year-old street block spans approximately 1,000 meters and is "popularly known as 'Foreigner's Street'."

Historical Background
"West Street is the oldest street in Yangshuo with a history of more than 1,400 years." The street developed from a residential area with scattered houses into a prosperous town. "Zhou Enlai, Chen Yun, Deng Xiaoping and other Chinese leaders had walked through this street." During the early 1980s, backpack tourists began arriving and staying for extended periods.

Current Character
"It now becomes a place that mixes the eastern and western culture harmoniously." The street features "signboards of all the stores and restaurants on this street have foreign names written on them, and foreigners are seen here and there."

Architecture & Design
Buildings blend Chinese and Western elements. Some structures "retained the style of primitive simplicity and elegant of north Guangxi buildings during the Ming and Qing dynasties," while cafes display European architectural styles with "three to four layers, the top has a bell tower and the castle."

Amenities & Activities
"At night, the restaurants in Foreigners' Street are crowded with diners. Decorated with tree bark, palm leaves and colorful lights, these restaurants all boast their own masterpieces."

Cultural Significance
"The world's most authoritative self-help travel guide Lonely Planet every year introduces Yangshuo West Street with plenty of space."

Visitor Information
The suggested visit duration is "2 or 3 hours to visit around the street." Buses from Guilin Train Station connect to Yangshuo County in approximately 1.5 hours.

sources.title: The Travel Guide for Yangshuo West Street | WindhorseTour
sources.content:
The Travel Guide for Yangshuo West Street

West Street is the oldest street in Yangshuo with a history of more than 1,400 years. The street spans 517 meters in length and 8 meters in width.

The street is regarded as the "Foreigners' Street" and also called as "Global Village". In the early 1970s, Yangshuo was opening to the outside world. Western visitors found West Street, those who were tired due to the bustling city and the fast pace of work found the "harbor" to have a rest here.

It is very calm and peaceful in the morning while it is trendy and modern in the evening. West Street is most vibrant at night. Arrive after sunset to experience the full energy of shops, food, and entertainment.

You can take part in some local activities in the Yangshuo West Street such as Taiji, calligraphy and Chinese chess. There are many restaurants, cafes and bars which offer travelers to have a good rest, both physically and psychologically. Street food is a great way to sample authentic local snacks and dishes.

Pashmina scarves, silk products and pottery, bronze, stone carvings were almost everywhere available on the West Street.

It is best to visit on weekdays. West Street is exceptionally busy during holidays and weekends (such as National Day and Spring Festival). Weekday evenings remain vibrant but are less overwhelming.

sources.title: Yangshuo West Street: Food, Shops, Travel Tips & More
sources.content:
Yangshuo West Street: Food, Shops, Travel Tips & More

West Street (Yangshuo Xijie) is a 1,400-year-old marvel that blends ancient Chinese heritage with western traveler vibes and serves as the oldest street in Yangshuo, making it a perfect starting point to explore Guilin's beauty.

Best Times to Visit: March - May and September - October are the best times considering both weather and scenery, while you should avoid the National Day holiday (usually Oct. 1 - 7). The best times of day are before 10:00 and after 19:00.

What to Expect: West Street is an 800-meter-long popular pedestrian street full of shops, restaurants, bars, guesthouses, and more, offering a good place to stroll, try local cuisine, buy souvenirs, and people watch. West Street transforms into a lively scene at night under glowing neon lights.

Food & Dining: The most famous Yangshuo specialty is beer fish, where the fish is deep-fried and then brewed with beer, tomato, and ginger. Besides Chinese restaurants, you can find restaurants serving Western food and catering to specific needs, including vegetarian, Indian, gluten-free, and halal.

Getting Around: The best way to experience West Street is on foot, walking on its historic bluestone lanes.

Tickets: Free, open all day. Recommended play time is 2-3 hours.

sources.title: West Street in Yangshuo, China - VisitGuilin.org
sources.content:
West Street in Yangshuo, China

West Street Yangshuo lies at the heart of town, spanning 517 meters in length and 8 meters in width. While its renovation lends a polished and contemporary feel, the street retains deep historical roots dating back over 1,400 years.

The street is open all day and is free to enter. It can be easily accessed via bike, a short taxi ride, or by foot from downtown Yangshuo.

West Street is most lively and fun at night, when the street is decorated with beautiful lights and tourists and locals alike gather to eat, shop, drink, and more. The best time to visit is April to October.

sources.title: 阳朔西街_百度百科
sources.content:
阳朔西街百度百科

基本信息
阳朔西街是"广西壮族自治区桂林市阳朔县的一条步行街"，位于古镇中心，长约800米、宽8米，呈东西走向。

历史发展
该街道拥有1400多年历史。真正始建于1674年，经历了从商业中心到文化街区的演变。"1966年因避讳'西'字改称东风路，1982年恢复旧名"。1984年改造为旅游文化街，1999-2004年完成保护性整治。

建筑特色
建筑保留了"小青瓦、坡屋顶、白粉墙、吊阳台"的桂北民居风格。街道采用大理石铺筑，呈弯曲S形，两侧为清代遗留的砖瓦房。

文化意义
西街是中西文化融合地，被称为"洋人街"和"地球村"。许多历史名人在此留下足迹，包括孙中山、徐悲鸿等艺术家，以及多国政要。

"洋人街"的形成
二十世纪七十年代初，阳朔对外开放，西方游客发现了西街，从此每年到西街观光、休闲的境外旅游者超过数十万人次。

十字街部分是县城繁华的商业中心，四大商家各踞十字路口一角，包括经营日杂烟酒的万利祥、经营南货土产出名的陈公兴，另有蒲同昌和元安商号。

特色美食与现状
街区汇聚啤酒鱼、田螺酿等传统美食，融合非遗品牌与新业态。2023年被评为"广西十佳夜游文化街区"，销售额超2.5亿元，年接待游客2300万人次。

sources.title: 阳朔西街游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content:
阳朔西街游玩攻略（携程）

门票：免费
开放时间：全天
建议游玩时间：2-3小时

阳朔西街是阳朔县最古老最繁华的街道，有着1400多年历史。青石板路、明清古建筑与充满异国情调的酒吧、咖啡馆和谐并存，营造出一种既传统又时尚的独特氛围。

西街因外国人聚集，又称为"洋人街"，长度不过数百米，却聚集了大大小小近百家商店、酒吧、饭馆。

晚上的西街特别热闹，有咖啡厅、西餐厅、迪吧酒吧，还有各种小工艺、小吃夜摊。

美食推荐：来西街一定要吃啤酒鱼，鱼吃起来鲜、香、嫩、滑，一点腥味都没有。

交通：桂林汽车总站、阳朔汽车站均有直达西街的公交线路。桂林西站高铁站下车后，乘坐高铁站专线大巴至阳朔汽车站，换乘公交或打车约20分钟可达。

温馨提示：商业化程度较高，部分商品价格可能偏高；节假日游客众多；夜晚部分区域可能比较喧闹。

sources.title: The West Street of Yangshuo - A Shopping Paradise
sources.content:
The West Street of Yangshuo - A Shopping Paradise

West Street (Yangshuo Xijie) lies at the heart of Yangshuo, stretching about 800 meters. Built with local marble (Banlang Wen Dali stone), the street features a distinctive dark, oily sheen. Buildings on both sides are low-rise brick and tile houses from the Qing Dynasty era, painted with white walls and red windows in classic Lingnan architectural style.

The street has become a cultural meeting point where Chinese and Western cultures blend. In the early 1970s, Yangshuo opened to the outside world. Western visitors discovered West Street and those tired from the bustling city found a "harbor" to rest. Since then, over hundreds of thousands of foreign tourists visit West Street annually for sightseeing and leisure.

West Street has evolved into a "Foreigners' Street," a "Global Village" transcending borders, and a large-scale "English Corner." The street is lined with shops, cafes, bars, and restaurants serving both Chinese and Western cuisine.
